title: Senior Account Executive, Mid-Market (NL)
searchText: Senior Account Executive, Mid-Market (NL) Reddit Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 121 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit www.redditinc.com . The international Mid-Market team is responsible to onboard & grow advertisers in EMEA and enable them to achieve their marketing objectives with Reddit’s proven advertising solutions. This is an opportunity for you to be part of the team that expands the Reddit footprint: design the strategy, develop a high performing sales team and bring the magic of Reddit into new markets! We're looking for sharp, positive and motivated self-starters to help us build this team from the ground up! In addition to laying the foundation of the team. Last year we introduced a new role into our Mid market team that is end to end responsible to grow our Head, Torso & Tail accounts. You will be responsible for your own book of Business, taking full ownership of strategic conversations, implementation & optimisations to grow the accounts. You will build & maintain a relationship at both client direct & agencies to meet their business objectives using Reddit's advertising suite. You will work closely with the wider AE community to define best practices, treatments and process improvements that allow for more sustainable growth, efficiency or scale. You will work with cross functional partners to continuously look for opportunities to improve, optimise and scale your work. This role is required to work in person from our Amsterdam office 3 days per week. Reddit offers a generous relocation package. Core Responsibilities : Act as the CEO of your book of business, and take full ownership of strategic bets, revenue forecasting, and ensuring operational rigor. Generate advertising revenue from assigned clients via ad agencies and advertisers directly, ensuring their needs are met and exceeded. Responsible for revenue quota of assigned book of business each quarter. Develop and execute strategic sales plans to meet and exceed revenue targets. Own client meetings from agenda to final presentation, instilling confidence and setting all interactions up for success by appropriately setting client expectations, identifying outcomes, and communicating clear next steps. Act as the primary point of contact for clients to communicate major platform updates, releases, changes, and/or opportunities that will deepen or expand the relationship. Provide strategic, proactive, and consultative advice to clients in order to uplevel and grow the relationship; Identify areas of additional opportunity within existing client relationships, including new lines of business, and move them through to close Communicate feedback on our sales processes, narratives, and products in order to advocate for customers and improve the team's effectiveness and efficiency. Implement & optimize campaigns (with the help of account strategists) to meet our clients’ advertising objectives through performance-driven or awareness campaigns. Pull and analyze data to compile compelling and actionable insights to move your clients' businesses forward. Translate client needs and requests into clear, actionable priorities for cross-functional stakeholders. Proactively and continually identify areas of improvement. Qualifications: 5+ years of relevant experience in online media sales (platform experience preferred) Strong understanding of the media landscape in The Netherlands. Client-facing experience in advertising sales, account management, or paid social campaign management Experience in monitoring marketing campaign performance, and make manual optimizations or strategic recommendations as needed Experience in Pulling and analyzing data to compile compelling and actionable insights to move your clients' businesses forward. Fluent in Dutch & English Users-first orientation Positive outlook, team player Demonstrated high achievement against sales targets Motivated self-starter who thrives in unstructured environments Solid understanding of customer marketing funnel and traditional marketing ecosystem Experience working with Looker Dashboards / Google Sheets and delivering actionable insights Understanding of digital measurement, tracking fundamentals and mobile measurement partners Tenacious and entrepreneurial approach to working through product, process, and client challenges Demonstrated ability to cultivate strong relationships with external partners Benefits Global Benefit programs that fit your lifestyle, from workspace to professional development to caregiving support Family Planning Support Gender-Affirming Care Mental Health & Coaching Benefits Private Pension plan with Employer-matching 100% employer-sponsored group medical plan Income Replacement Programs Flexible Vacation & Paid Volunteer Time Off Generous Paid Parental Leave In select roles and locations, the interviews will be recorded, transcribed and summarized by artificial intelligence (AI). You will have the opportunity to opt out of recording, transcription and summarization prior to any scheduled interviews. During the interview, we will collect the following categories of personal information: Identifiers, Professional and Employment-Related Information, Sensory Information (audio/video recording), and any other categories of personal information you choose to share with us. We will use this information to evaluate your application for employment or an independent contractor role, as applicable. We will not sell your personal information or disclose it to any third party for their marketing purposes. We will delete any recording of your interview promptly after making a hiring decision. For more information about how we will handle your personal information, including our retention of it, please refer to our Candidate Privacy Policy for Potential Employees and Contractors . Reddit is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and is committed to building a workforce representative of the diverse communities we serve. Reddit is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If, due to a disability, you need an accommodation during the interview process, please let your recruiter know. Reddit is a community of communities.
